title: Utilize a worksheet to prepare the statement of cash flows

items.concept: Initial recognition worksheet JEs (equipment purchase; stock issuance); subsequent depreciation; period-end WC adjusting worksheet JEs; equipment disposal worksheet JE; complete worksheet; formal indirect SCF
Number-variant twin: reconstruct worksheet entries for WC, depreciation schedule, equipment disposal, note principal settlement, stock issuance; prepare formal SCF

Period-end and settlement reconstructed worksheet JEs — equipment disposal, early bond retirement (settlement), bond premium amortization (subsequent measurement), NI and dividends; classify each lower-half amount O/I/F
Classification / presentation — lower-half worksheet convention (additions = debits; deductions = credits) and correct reconstructed entry for a bond issued at a discount
